issues.body: The prior-round finding remains unchanged. `env PATH="/nonexistent" bash "$SCRIPT" ...` asks `env` to locate `bash` using the replaced PATH, so it returns 127 before build-guide.sh runs. The assertion therefore passes even if the builder's `command -v mdbook` guard is removed or broken.
issues.fix_hint: Resolve bash before replacing PATH (for example, capture `BASH_BIN=$(command -v bash)` and invoke `env PATH=/nonexistent "$BASH_BIN" "$SCRIPT" ...`). Also assert that stderr contains the builder's actionable `mdbook not found` diagnostic so the test proves the intended branch executed.
issues.title: Missing-mdbook test still passes without executing the builder

verdict.summary: The production guide publishing path and its anti-drift checks remain coherent, but the prior round's minor test-validity defect is unchanged: the absent-mdbook case still replaces PATH before resolving bash, so it can pass without executing build-guide.sh. No blocker or major correctness, soundness, or security issue was found in the supplied diff.
